text: Free demo with one goal: roll until every single die lands on six.
You start with three dice and terrible odds.
Every roll pays coins. Spend them on faster rolls, upgrades, and risky bets.
Best part: you can corrupt your dice. Sacrifice the other faces to make six more likely.
And you can plaster the machine in stickers, for no reason at all.
The catch? The rainbow unlock effect looks cheap next to the neat retro screen.
It's tiny, under three hundred megabytes, and all four demo reviews are positive.
Think Cookie Clicker, with Balatro's odds.
Worth a dip. Six is devil.
